traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Malus (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.65 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 34 records in 12 sources); trunks 0.65, branches 0.63. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full, as Pyrus: calyx-tube urn-shaped; ovary inferior, 2- to 5-celled; stamens about 20; petals white or pink, clawed. For Pacific crab apple (Pyrus rivularis) carpels commonly 3; the Burke Herbarium (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read) gives 3 (or 4) styles and about 20 stamens.
